messages.context: 首次进入 Jax 的箭矢工坊
messages.text: Hello %s! What brings you to my workshop? I forge the newest and most powerful arrows in all of SkyBlock!
messages.zh: 你好,%s! 什么风把你吹到我的工坊来了? 全 SkyBlock 最新、最强的箭都出自我手!

segments.text: ! What brings you to my workshop? I forge the newest and most powerful arrows in all of SkyBlock!
segments.zh: ! 什么风把你吹到我的工坊来了? 全 SkyBlock 最新、最强的箭都出自我手!

messages.context: 首次进入 Jax 的箭矢工坊
messages.text: If you can prove to me you're a real archer I'll forge you arrows whenever you need them.
messages.zh: 只要向我证明你是真正的弓箭手,往后缺箭就来找我锻造。

messages.text: Ready to test your skills? Step on the pressure plate and all the targets will light up, if you can shoot them all in 25 seconds, I'll know you're the real deal.
messages.zh: 准备好大显身手了吗? 踏上压力板后,所有目标都会亮起。若你能在 25 秒内将它们全部射中,我就承认你是真材实料。

messages.raw: §fWow, you can really shoot a bow!
messages.text: Wow, you can really shoot a bow!
messages.zh: 哇,你还真会射箭!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fWell, a deal's a deal! Come to me any time and I'll forge you whatever arrows you need for adventures.
messages.text: Well, a deal's a deal! Come to me any time and I'll forge you whatever arrows you need for adventures.
messages.zh: 说话算话! 随时来找我,冒险要用什么箭,我都给你造。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fI have only one condition... These are powerful arrows, they can't fall into the wrong hands so keep them in your quiver and don't share them with anyone.
messages.text: I have only one condition... These are powerful arrows, they can't fall into the wrong hands so keep them in your quiver and don't share them with anyone.
messages.zh: 我只有一个条件……这些箭威力很强,可不能落到不该拿的人手里。放好在你的箭袋里,别分给别人。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.context: Abiphone Contact | Before Completing Target Practice III
messages.raw: §fUh... maybe before you dare get my contact, you should prove yourself as a real archer first.
messages.text: Uh... maybe before you dare get my contact, you should prove yourself as a real archer first.
messages.zh: 呃……想要我的联系方式,是不是得先证明自己是个真正的弓箭手?
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fMy Abiphone contact?
messages.text: My Abiphone contact?
messages.zh: 我的 Abiphone 联系方式?
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fListen pal, I've been nice with you but it's strictly business etiquette.
messages.text: Listen pal, I've been nice with you but it's strictly business etiquette.
messages.zh: 听着,我对你客气,那只是做生意的礼数。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fI'm freaking Jax the Archer, you see those lanterns? I can clear them all in 11 seconds!
messages.text: I'm freaking Jax the Archer, you see those lanterns? I can clear them all in 11 seconds!
messages.zh: 我可是神射手 Jax! 看见那些灯笼了吗? 我 11 秒就能全打掉!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fI'm just that good!
messages.text: I'm just that good!
messages.zh: 我就是这么厉害!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fIf you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER 11 seconds.
messages.text: If you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER 11 seconds.
messages.zh: 想要我的联系方式,就拿出本事来,用不到 11 秒把它们全射中。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fOtherwise you'll have to give me §6%s§f coins to get my contact, no less.
messages.text: Otherwise you'll have to give me %s coins to get my contact, no less.
messages.zh: 不然就给我 %s 硬币买联系方式,一分都不能少。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

segments.text: Otherwise you'll have to give me
coins to get my contact, no less.
segments.zh: 硬币买联系方式,一分都不能少。

messages.raw: §fWhat do you say, buddy?
messages.text: What do you say, buddy?
messages.zh: 怎么样,你选哪条路?
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fDelusional are we today?
messages.text: Delusional are we today?
messages.zh: 今天这么有自信,是不是有点想多了?
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fAlright let me know when you realize the massive skill gap between us.
messages.text: Alright let me know when you realize the massive skill gap between us.
messages.zh: 行,等你认清咱俩射术差得有多远,再来告诉我。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fI unlocked §4Target Partice IV§f for you, good luck kiddo.
messages.text: I unlocked Target Partice IV for you, good luck kiddo.
messages.gloss: Wiki 原文拼作 Target Partice IV,保留来源拼写。IV 是本次解锁的固定挑战档次。
messages.zh: 我给你解锁了靶场练习 IV,祝你好运,小子。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fDid you...
messages.text: Did you...
messages.zh: 你该不会……
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fI mean...
messages.text: I mean...
messages.zh: 我是说……
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fwat. How??
messages.text: wat. How??
messages.zh: 什么。怎么做到的??
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fTake my contact and go.
messages.text: Take my contact and go.
messages.zh: 拿好我的联系方式,走吧。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fYou're poor too, huh?
messages.text: You're poor too, huh?
messages.zh: 你还没钱,是吧?
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fCome back when you have the money.
messages.text: Come back when you have the money.
messages.zh: 带够钱再来。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.raw: §fYep, that's right, I'm the best.
messages.text: Yep, that's right, I'm the best.
messages.zh: 对,没错,我就是最强的。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 September 2026, at 13:13.

messages.zh: 只收你 %s 百万硬币,你就偷着乐吧,我完全可以再加个零。

note:
身份: 箭矢工匠和自负的神射手。
关系: 先考验玩家,再提供锻箭和通讯服务。
口吻: 直白,爱吹嘘;被击败后结巴。
性格: 好胜,以射术自豪。
禁用: 不改挑战时限,不替玩家编造成绩,不增加辱骂。
